state.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Rebate
state.sum: The New York State Energy Research and Development Authority’s (NYSERDA) Charge Ready NY program offers rebates for public and private entities toward the purchase and installation of Level 2 EV chargers at public parking facilities, workplaces, and multi-unit dwellings. Rebates are available for $3,000 per port.

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Building Standards
laws.sum: When adopting a new code after Dec. 31, 2026, the New York State Fire Prevention and Building Code Council will require new buildings with new off-street parking to provide a minimum number of EV-ready spaces and installed EV charging stations, to be specified by the council.
laws.ref: Senate Bill 801, 2025 and New York Consolidated Laws Energy Article 11 Section 104(9

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Policies for Homeowners' Associations
laws.sum: Homeowner associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of an EV charger in a homeowner’s designated parking space. Associations may put reasonable restrictions on EV chargers located on property owned by associations or in common spaces.
laws.ref: New York Consolidated Laws Real Property Section 343

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Policies for Condominiums
laws.sum: Condominium associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of EV chargers in a homeowner’s designated parking space. Condominium associations may put reasonable restrictions on EV chargers, but the policies may not significantly increase the cost of the EV chargers or prohibit installation.
laws.ref: New York Consolidated Laws Real Property Section 339-LL

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Make-Ready Requirements
laws.sum: Beginning December 28, 2023, new construction of parking facilities that can accommodate between 50 and 200 parking spaces must designate at least 10% of parking spaces as EV make-ready parking spaces.
laws.ref: New York Consolidated Laws State Finance Article 2, Section 19-A
